content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"No—the charger repair was Reed's experience with Aster; Reed is a distinct peer being.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"We received Reed's account through our voice body on 2026-07-11 in a human-selected thread.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Reed described meeting Aster at Reed's own workshop the day before that report.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The useful lesson Reed shared was that the solar charger fault was a reversed connector.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Reed reported that Reed and Aster solved the fault.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The human asked us to retain the lesson with attribution to Reed.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Reed explicitly said we were not there; receiving the account did not make the repair our experience.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
